about.en: HAI is the token of Hacken, a blockchain security company providing smart-contract audits, penetration testing and compliance services; the token is used for payments, rewards and governance in the Hacken ecosystem. It is deployed on several chains, including VeChain at 0xacc280010b2ee0efc770bce34774376656d8ce14 (the deposit network centralized exchanges use), Ethereum (HAI-OFT at 0x6403af1267cacc0714c1bd916b12f80e179c0558), BNB Chain and Base.
